heart_failure_historical_v1.description: Historical heart-failure list: ICD-10 prefix I50 and ICD-9 prefix 428. This is the definition behind the previously reported counts.

heart_failure_expanded_v1.description: Broader heart-failure research phenotype. Includes the historical I50/428 family plus selected hypertensive and rheumatic heart-failure codes. Not a replacement for historical counts.

stroke_historical_v1.description: Historical stroke list: ICD-10 prefix I63 and ICD-9 prefix 434.

stroke_expanded_v1.description: Broader stroke research phenotype including hemorrhagic and unspecified stroke. Not a replacement for historical counts.

mi_historical_v1.description: Historical myocardial-infarction list: exact ICD-10 I21.9 and ICD-9 prefix 410.9. This is intentionally narrow.

mi_expanded_v1.description: Broader myocardial-infarction research phenotype: ICD-10 I21*/I22* and ICD-9 410*. Not a replacement for historical counts.

mimic_coding_overlap.interpretation: Same-encounter ICD-9 and ICD-10 matches can be dual entry or a crosswalk, not two separate diseases. Run this on a real extract before interpreting overlap.

mimic_task.positive_definition: New encounter with start strictly after the index anchor and at most 30.0 days later. Any diagnosis counts. This is not a repeat of the cohort-defining code.
mimic_task.negative_definition: No new encounter in the horizon, and observation continues through the horizon.
mimic_task.censor_definition: Observation ends before the horizon without a qualifying encounter.
mimic_task.anchor_definition: Anchor is the index encounter end: discharge time when an admission table provides it, otherwise the last in-encounter event time.
